why_it_passes: accepting an invite sent to the person's own address, in their signed-in browser; the check asks Tailscale itself

input.title: Accept the invite to the team's Tailscale network
input.brief:
1. If the Tailscale app is not running on bea-mac, install it from https://tailscale.com/download/mac and open it.
2. Open the email from Tailscale to bea@example.com with the subject "You've been invited to join example-org.github on Tailscale".
3. Press Accept invite. If Tailscale asks you to sign in, sign in with the Google account bea@example.com.
4. When the page asks which device, choose bea-mac, the Mac you are on.
5. Open https://login.tailscale.com/admin/machines and confirm bea-mac is listed.
